tie_reference: TIE (2026). Business Studies for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 2. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.
source_note: Verified Business Studies Form Two lesson plans (Arusha Catholic Seminary). 21 lesson plans covering the Concept of Production, Financing of Small Businesses, Small Business Management and review/continuous assessment (Term I), then Warehousing and Inventorying, Business Opportunity Identification, review and the Practical Business Plan Project (Term II). One verified lesson per teaching week (3 periods each); weeks for mid-term assessments, annual-exam revision and the annual examinations carry no teaching content and are intentionally omitted. Content kept verbatim from the educator-verified source for offline and AI generation grounding.
